envVars.name: SIMMER_API_KEY
envVars.description: Your Simmer SDK API key. Get one from simmer.markets/dashboard.

envVars.name: TRADING_VENUE
envVars.description: Venue for scans and for scripts/status.py: 'sim' (default, paper), 'polymarket', or 'kalshi'. Real venues only take orders when you also pass --live.

envVars.name: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
envVars.description: Only needed for external-wallet self-custody trading on a real venue. Leave unset when using a Simmer managed wallet or the default sim venue.
